StreamData is part of 1 of my public repositories, from 2026 to 2026.

What it was for: [AI engineering](@/projects/ai.md) (1).

Most recently: [llm](@/work/llm.md): Local-first, provider-agnostic archive of AI conversations (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Codex) — immutable, content-addressed, searchable evidence layer built in Elixir/Ecto.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses StreamData: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links StreamData to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
